npc.ganbaatar.1: Wool, milk — bring your goods, I pay a fair price.
npc.ganbaatar.2: Wool prices are high today — bring your load quickly.
npc.ganbaatar.3: A seller who brings two kinds of goods in one trip is the best kind.
npc.sarangerel.1: You are family — come on in, the door is open.
npc.sarangerel.2: If you bring milk or tarag, my parents will be glad — send my greetings.
npc.sarangerel.3: The grocery will open fully soon — please wait a little.
npc.oyuntsetseg.1: Some tea? The mutton is stewing — sit and eat.
npc.oyuntsetseg.2: A few people came by this week looking for work.
npc.oyuntsetseg.3: If you need a good helper, drop by my teahouse.
npc.dorjpalam.1: Get your livestock vaccinated — spring brings fewer sicknesses.
npc.dorjpalam.2: Keep warm water and a clean cloth ready when the young are born.
npc.dorjpalam.3: I make rounds of the families by day; I am at the clinic in the evening.
npc.tsetsegmaa.1: The children study well — visit the library over summer.
npc.tsetsegmaa.2: Learn the Mongolian script; it matters for country children too.
npc.tsetsegmaa.3: The children board here in winter — send my regards to your family.
npc.batsukh.1: A district governor must always think of the people.
npc.batsukh.2: Repay a livestock loan on time and your reputation grows.
npc.batsukh.3: The district only thrives when state and people stand together.
npc.sarnai.1: Welcome. Take your money and count it, friend.
npc.sarnai.2: The bank helps herders with loans and savings.
npc.sarnai.3: In a hard winter, those with savings sleep easier.
npc.baatarsukh.1: Keep to the rules and we have little to do.
npc.baatarsukh.2: Livestock theft rises in winter — count your herd.
npc.baatarsukh.3: Mind the traffic rules out there, friend.
npc.lkhagvasuren.1: Petrol, diesel — how much do you need?
npc.lkhagvasuren.2: A fuel delivery arrives tomorrow; there is enough for now.
npc.lkhagvasuren.3: On cold days, warm up your engine first.
npc.luvsan.1: A donation to the temple gathers merit.
npc.luvsan.2: Good deeds follow those with good intentions.
npc.luvsan.3: Make an offering each morning for the health of your herd.
npc.khuslen.2: Our teacher is strict but kind.
npc.khuslen.3: I am staying in town this summer to play with friends.
npc.erdenebat.1: The dorm is cold but I have many friends.
npc.erdenebat.2: When I grow up I will be a herder.
npc.erdenebat.3: I would love to watch the wrestling.
npc.tenuun.2: The teacher says there is a test today.
npc.tenuun.3: My parents are at their camp.
npc.uyanga.2: Michidmaa and I are best friends.
npc.uyanga.3: I could not go home this summer, so I stayed.
npc.michidmaa.2: I would love to raise a lamb.
npc.michidmaa.3: Everyone in my class is nice.
npc.zolboo.1: Let us go to the playground!
npc.zolboo.2: I will be a clever child.
npc.bilgee.1: The teacher read me a story.
npc.bilgee.2: I played with my friends at kindergarten.
npc.ganzorig.1: I am a big kid — I start school soon.
npc.ganzorig.2: I want to ride a horse.
npc.ganzorig.3: Mom comes for me in the evening.
npc.damdin.1: Tea is best when you sit and enjoy it. Join me.
npc.damdin.2: In the old days there was no town like this.
npc.damdin.3: Think of your herd first, young one.
npc.tserendulam.1: I came to the temple to pray.
npc.tserendulam.2: My granddaughter studies at the school.
npc.munkhbat.1: I came from camp to buy fuel.
npc.munkhbat.2: I keep my horse, and there is a motorbike too.
npc.munkhbat.3: They say there are more wolves this year.
npc.nyamaa.1: I will unload and be on my way.
